usedFor: Didit checks identity, and “Create Verification Session” starts a verification of a person or document.

bestTemplate.name: “New Deal Won” in Teamgate, then “Create Verification Session” in Didit
bestTemplate.why: A won deal is a point to confirm who the customer is, and the action opens the verification session.

watchOut: The session reports back through a completion callback, so plan where that result goes.
